items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Like that old Hollywood actress named Clara Bow.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was in that group. We had a chick playing piano, her name was Clara Bowe.
Like that old Hollywood actress named Clara Bow.

That's right. So she was with us. He wanted musicians... He sent over here. We joined him in Baltimore. And I stayed with him in Baltimore, and I played the Howard and I played the Apollo and I played the Earle in Philadelphia. We did the last show in there; they tore it down after the show we did. Dinah Washington was on the bill with us, and Mope and Pope (that's a comedy team), and somebody else... It was a show. So we had to play... See, when we got on there, they had them arrangements to play for those…
